contrast.positive_log2fc: higher relative HP1 enrichment in cercariae SmVEN than sporocysts SmDFO; not an isolated developmental-stage effect

pairing_rationale: The methods describe separate strain-specific sources and do not establish matched biological units across stages. No paired analysis is justified by the published design.

publication_evidence.section: Materials and Methods: Extraction of sporocysts and cercariae
publication_evidence.sporocyst_source: Dissection of infected Biomphalaria glabrata BgGUA carrying S. mansoni SmDFO; two samples obtained per snail.
publication_evidence.cercaria_source: Light-induced shedding of S. mansoni SmVEN from snails, followed by aliquoting.

confounding.scope_of_inference: Differences between the combined stage-strain groups only; separate developmental and strain contributions cannot be estimated.

biological_independence.required_evidence: Map each deposited library to its source snail, independently collected biological pool, and any sample/aliquot splits, including relationships within each group.
biological_independence.pseudoreplication_risk: Two sporocyst samples per snail are described, but their correspondence to sequenced libraries is not specified; separate aliquots do not establish independent biological replication.

shared_control_limitation: one Input library per stage; sharing it does not create independent Input replicates
